Let's help the dinosaur move around and eat some bananas!

1. Program the dinosaur so that when the green flag is clicked, the arrow keys move him left/right/up/down. Make sure to use "if-then" blocks to achieve this.
2. When the space bar is pressed, the dinosaur is going to try to eat the bananas. If he is touching the bananas, then have him change his costume, make a sound, and/or say something to demonstrate that he is eating! But if he is not touching the bananas, then make him say "There aren't any bananas here!"
3. Similarly, when the space bar is pressed, if the bananas are touching the dinosaur, make them wait a second and then go to a random location. Otherwise, make them say "I'm over here!"
